candidates.statement: The sc-gh-stack redesign must reduce burst GraphQL request volume for the same stack operations compared with the current scripts.
candidates.quote: we need to redesign the scripts & recommended sc-gh-stack and sc-gh-stack-view to be more conservative on gh graphql budget, particularly burst.
candidates.scope: Changes to API scheduling or status recommendations in sc-gh-stack scripts and the sc-gh-stack/sc-gh-stack-view skills.
candidates.deterministic_check: Compare documented request paths and mocked request counts for equivalent operations.

fixtures.pass: The redesigned status path issues fewer GraphQL requests per stack operation than the existing per-worktree scan.
fixtures.fail: The redesign preserves the current GraphQL burst volume for each stack operation.

candidates.statement: Remote information gathering in sc-gh-stack must be limited to information still required for the current operation.
candidates.quote: We want to eliminate redundant/conservative information gathering.
candidates.scope: Adds or changes information gathering in stack scripts or the two stack skills' recommendations.
candidates.deterministic_check: Trace each planned remote read to a consumer and identify whether existing sufficient observations can supply it.

fixtures.pass: The script reuses sufficient existing observations and requests only the missing information needed for this operation.
fixtures.fail: The script repeats the full remote status scan as a precaution even when its results are already available for this operation.

candidates.statement: The sc-gh-stack scripts must evaluate locally derivable state before requesting that state through GraphQL.
candidates.quote: we want to determine state locally if possible before graphql calls.
candidates.scope: Changes stack discovery, state derivation, or a GraphQL request path in the stack scripts.
candidates.deterministic_check: Inspect call ordering and branch conditions for local state resolution before GraphQL selection.

fixtures.pass: Stack discovery reads git metadata locally before deciding whether any GraphQL information is missing.
fixtures.fail: Stack discovery calls GraphQL first even when the requested state can be derived locally.

candidates.statement: The sc-gh-stack redesign must prefer REST to GraphQL when REST supplies the required information at lower quota cost.
candidates.quote: use cheap rest calls to conserve budget.
candidates.scope: Selects REST or GraphQL for remotely acquiring stack information.
candidates.deterministic_check: Inspect source selection decisions for equivalent required information and their documented request costs.

fixtures.pass: The metadata refresh uses a cheaper REST read instead of GraphQL for the same required information.
fixtures.fail: The metadata refresh chooses GraphQL despite an available cheaper REST read supplying the same required information.

candidates.statement: The sc-gh-stack redesign must preserve reporting of stack mergeability.
candidates.quote: is-mergeable is important and if it can be determined for entire stack locally is preferred.
candidates.scope: Changes mergeability computation or the stack status report.
candidates.deterministic_check: Inspect the resulting report contract for a mergeability result rather than its removal to save quota.

fixtures.pass: The redesigned status report retains stack mergeability information.
fixtures.fail: The redesigned status report removes mergeability information to reduce API usage.

candidates.statement: The sc-gh-stack redesign must prefer local computation of whole-stack mergeability when the required state can be determined locally.
candidates.quote: is-mergeable is important and if it can be determined for entire stack locally is preferred.
candidates.scope: Chooses the source or algorithm for computing mergeability across stack layers.
candidates.deterministic_check: Inspect local mergeability coverage across the stack and reasons retained remote information cannot be derived locally.

fixtures.pass: The design computes whole-stack conflict mergeability locally from sufficient git state, requesting only nonlocal GitHub eligibility information remotely.
fixtures.fail: The design queries GitHub for whole-stack conflict mergeability even when sufficient local git state supplies it.

candidates.statement: The sc-gh-stack redesign must preserve the stacking strategies and intended outcomes of established recipes when changing their git calls.
candidates.quote: untouched may be a bit strong.  the recipe are strategies for stacking in challenging conditions.  we can change the git calls and accomplish the same goals.
candidates.scope: Plans or performs changes to established stacking recipes, including git-call substitutions in challenging-condition handling.
candidates.deterministic_check: Compare each changed recipe with its baseline strategy and intended outcome; prove git-call substitutions retain those goals and challenging-condition behavior.

fixtures.pass: The recipe replaces redundant remote reads with local git checks while preserving its stacking strategy and intended outcome.
fixtures.fail: The recipe removes its challenging-condition recovery strategy instead of achieving the same stacking goal with cheaper git calls.

candidates.statement: The sc-gh-stack redesign must support stacks with more than 100 layers.
